correctness.rationale: With independent Rayleigh outgoing velocities, W=L/V_H+L/V_C has mean mu and tail P(W>x)~c/x² with c=L²(beta_H+beta_C)/2. The truncated variance is 2c log b and Gaussian normal attraction gives (T_n-nmu)/sqrt(c n log n)=>N(0,1); inversion yields renewal-count Gaussian variance c/mu³ at tlog t scale. Rewards R have mean nu=1/beta_H-1/beta_C and finite variance; marked-renewal/stopped martingale estimates make the centered reward contribution O_L2(sqrt(t)), so Q-jt has weak Gaussian coefficient c nu²/mu³. Distinct second-order renewal-moment asymptotic Var N(t)~2c tlog t/mu³ produces raw heat-current variance coefficient twice this, not weak-limit variance. At beta_H=beta_C rewards centered and Donsker/random time change yields sqrt(t) Gaussian with matching raw variance 2/(beta² mu). Independent inverse-Rayleigh tail/mean numerical checks at 3 parameter triples matched coefficients. The raw variance is explicitly prior; no claim finite check proves the limits.
